# WF-TR-01 Thread Resolver — Test Matrix (v2.0)

> **Status:** pre_live_ready (candidate, advance_allowed=false)  
> **Test Framework:** Fixture-driven (NO scripts/tr_logic.py, NO test_families.py)  
> **Test Vectors:** 16 anchor test cases derived from `/tests/fixtures/` directory  
> **Execution Model:** Static (design-level) and runtime (requires DB setup)

---

## 1. Test Framework Notes

**WF-TR-01 uses fixture-driven testing model** — test cases are **not** generated by Python scripts or test families. Instead:

- 16 fixture JSON files in `tests/fixtures/` define test inputs and expected outputs
- Each fixture is self-contained (TC-01 through TC-16)
- Some fixtures run at design-level (no DB required); others require full DB setup via `setup_test_data.sql`
- No `scripts/tr_logic.py` exists; no `test_families.py` exists
- Test validation is done manually via TEST_AFTER_IMPORT_WF-TR-01.md test guide

**This is structurally different from WF-ME-01** and other module workflows that may use py-based test generation. WF-TR-01's fixture approach provides **direct evidence** of behavior without abstraction.

## 3. Test Type Definitions

### Design-Level Tests (No DB Required)

These tests validate logic paths and contracts without database setup:

- **TC-01:** Explicit thread reference (shortcircuit immediate)
- **TC-05:** Create new thread (no semantic match case)
- **TC-07:** Invalid input (missing message_id)
- **TC-09:** Cross-tenant isolation (request-time filtering)
- **TC-10:** Content class behavior (normalized_content vs raw_content)
- **TC-11:** Whitespace-only content (validation)

**Execution:** Can run immediately after workflow import without setup_test_data.sql.

### Runtime Tests (Require DB Setup)

These tests require full database with test data:

- **TC-02:** Direct reply linkage (queries messages table)
- **TC-03:** Attach by entity + semantic match (queries threads, entities, scores)
- **TC-04:** Reopen latent thread (queries threads with status=latent)
- **TC-06:** Ambiguous candidate set (queries 2+ threads with similar scores)
- **TC-08:** Deterministic replay (idempotency via ON CONFLICT)
- **TC-12:** reply_to_thread_id explicit (priority 1b shortcircuit)
- **TC-13:** Latent above attach threshold (reopen vs attach decision)
- **TC-14:** Exact boundary score (0.75 >= threshold)
- **TC-15:** Reply to message with no thread_id (fallback to create_new)
- **TC-16:** Audit write error path (error audit table write)

**Execution:** Requires `setup_test_data.sql` loaded first.

---

## 4. Oracle Types

### Direct Assertion

Input → immediate validation logic → decision (no external state lookup required).

**Examples:** TC-01 (explicit thread), TC-05 (no match), TC-07 (missing field)

### DB Lookup + Assertion

Input → query database → match against result → decision.

**Examples:** TC-02 (reply linkage), TC-03 (scoring), TC-04 (latent reopen)

### Threshold Assertion

Scored result >= threshold → decision based on numeric comparison.

**Examples:** TC-14 (score exactly 0.75), TC-13 (latent above attach threshold)

### Margin-Gap Assertion

Top 2 candidates' scores differ by < ambiguity_margin → ambiguity fired → create_new.

**Example:** TC-06 (two threads with similar semantic scores)

### Scoring Assertion

Entity match + semantic match + temporal + channel = total score → compared to threshold.

**Example:** TC-03 (0.30 + 0.35 + 0.15 + 0.10 = 0.90 >= 0.75)

### Idempotency Assertion

Same input with same idempotency_key → same resolution_id across replays.

**Example:** TC-08 (deterministic replay)

### Validation Assertion

Required field missing or malformed → validation error → fail_invalid_input.

**Examples:** TC-07, TC-11, TC-16 (error paths)

### Tenant Filter Assertion

Queries filtered by tenant_id → no cross-tenant thread leakage.

**Example:** TC-09 (separate tenants see different threads)

### Content Class Assertion

Normalized_content consumed; raw_content NOT consumed in result logic.

**Example:** TC-10 (nested shape with raw_content present but not used)

### Priority Assertion

Explicit refs (thread_id, reply_to_thread_id) bypass scoring entirely.

**Examples:** TC-01 (priority 1), TC-12 (priority 1b)

## 7. Test Coverage Dimensions

### Input Validation

- **TC-07:** Missing required field (message_id) → fail_invalid_input
- **TC-11:** Whitespace-only normalized_content → fail_invalid_input
- **TC-16:** Error audit path verification (invalid direction/author_type)

**Coverage:** 100% (all validation rules from Section 9 of ThreadResolutionContracts.md covered)

### Decision Paths

| Path | Test Case | Coverage |
|---|---|---|
| Priority 1: explicit thread_id shortcircuit | TC-01 | ✅ |
| Priority 1b: reply_to_thread_id shortcircuit | TC-12 | ✅ |
| Priority 2: reply_to_message_id → DB lookup | TC-02 | ✅ |
| Priority 3-5: scoring (entity + semantic) | TC-03 | ✅ |
| Latent reopen path | TC-04, TC-13 | ✅ |
| Ambiguity detection | TC-06 | ✅ |
| Create new thread (no match) | TC-05 | ✅ |
| Boundary conditions (score = 0.75) | TC-14 | ✅ |
| Cross-tenant isolation | TC-09 | ✅ |

**Coverage:** 100% (all decision paths executable)

### Idempotency & Audit

| Aspect | Test Case | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Deterministic resolution_id | TC-08 | replay same input → same resolution_id (ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING) |
| Error audit write | TC-16 | error path writes to thread_resolution_audit |
| Candidate scores in audit | TC-03 | candidate_scores JSONB field populated |
| All decisions audited | TC-01, TC-03, TC-04, TC-07 | success and error paths both write audit |

**Coverage:** 100% (audit idempotency verified per design)

### Scoring Components

| Component | Test Case | Verification |
|---|---|---|
| Entity match (0.0-0.30) | TC-03 | Primary entity → 0.30 |
| Semantic match (0.0-0.40) | TC-03 | Word overlap Romanian stemming |
| Temporal proximity (0.0-0.20) | TC-03 | Thread activity within 24h |
| Channel relevance (0.0-0.10) | TC-03 | Message channel in thread.source_channels |
| Total score computation | TC-03 | 0.30 + 0.35 + 0.15 + 0.10 = 0.90 |

**Coverage:** 100% (all components tested via TC-03)

### Thresholds & Configuration

| Threshold | Test Case | Verification |
|---|---|---|
| attach_threshold (0.75) | TC-03, TC-14 | score >= 0.75 → attach |
| reopen_threshold (0.65) | TC-04 | score >= 0.65 → reopen latent |
| ambiguity_margin (0.05) | TC-06 | top 2 scores differ < 0.05 → ambiguity |
| ambiguity_minimum (0.60) | TC-06 | best score < 0.60 → always create new |
| candidate_window (30 days) | TC-03, TC-04 | threads outside window excluded |
| max_candidates (50) | TC-03 | limit enforced in SQL query |

**Coverage:** 100% (all thresholds tested)

### Input Shapes

| Shape | Test Case | Coverage |
|---|---|---|
| Flat shape (MVP) | TC-01 through TC-09, TC-11 through TC-16 | 15 fixtures |
| Nested shape (Phase 2+) | TC-10 | 1 fixture |

**Coverage:** 100% (both shapes tested)

## 8. Test Execution Checklist (Per TEST_AFTER_IMPORT_WF-TR-01.md)

### Pre-Execution Setup

- [ ] PostgreSQL running and accessible
- [ ] All prerequisite tables exist (tenants, threads, entities, messages, thread_resolution_audit)
- [ ] setup_test_data.sql has been run
- [ ] All PostgreSQL nodes configured with credentials
- [ ] All nodes have alwaysOutputData = true
- [ ] n8n v1.30+ confirmed

### Design-Level Tests (No DB, can run immediately)

- [ ] TC-01: Explicit thread reference → attach_existing_thread, confidence=1.0
- [ ] TC-05: Create new thread → create_new_thread, confidence=0.0
- [ ] TC-07: Invalid input → fail_invalid_input, error.code=INVALID_INPUT
- [ ] TC-09: Cross-tenant isolation → separate tenant queries
- [ ] TC-10: Content class behavior → normalized_content used, raw_content ignored
- [ ] TC-11: Whitespace-only content → fail_invalid_input

### Runtime Tests (Require setup_test_data.sql)

- [ ] TC-02: Direct reply linkage → attach_existing_thread
- [ ] TC-03: Attach by entity + semantic → attach_existing_thread, score >= 0.75
- [ ] TC-04: Reopen latent thread → reopen_latent_thread, confidence >= 0.65
- [ ] TC-06: Ambiguous candidate set → create_new_thread, ambiguity_detected=true
- [ ] TC-08: Deterministic replay → identical resolution_id on second execution
- [ ] TC-12: reply_to_thread_id explicit → attach_existing_thread (shortcircuit)
- [ ] TC-13: Latent above attach threshold → reopen_latent_thread (not attach)
- [ ] TC-14: Exact boundary score (0.75) → attach_existing_thread
- [ ] TC-15: Reply to message with no thread_id → create_new_thread
- [ ] TC-16: Audit write error path → error audit record written

### Post-Test Verification

- [ ] All 16 test cases pass with correct decisions
- [ ] Idempotency test produces identical resolution_id on replay
- [ ] Cross-tenant test shows no thread contamination
- [ ] Ambiguity test produces ambiguity_detected=true
- [ ] Scoring paths produce correct component breakdown
- [ ] All error results have error.code and error.missing_fields
- [ ] All success results have error=null (explicitly)
- [ ] All results include module_name="thread_resolver" and result_type="resolution"
- [ ] Audit table has exactly one row per resolution_id (no duplicates)
- [ ] All timestamps are ISO 8601 valid
- [ ] All UUID fields are valid UUIDs or null
- [ ] Confidence scores are 0.0-1.0 range
